name: humanitarian-mcp

tools.name: search_country
tools.description: Resolve a free-text country query ("egypt", "DRC", "syria") to canonical names and ISO3 codes. Use this first when unsure how a country is spelled in the data.

query.description: Country name fragment, ISO2/ISO3 code or alias

tools.name: country_profile
tools.description: One-call humanitarian snapshot of a country: latest displaced population hosted (by category), population displaced FROM the country, and its top origin countries.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare a displacement metric across 2–5 countries over a year range. Defaults to refugees hosted (role "asylum") over the last 10 years. Set normalize_by to compare per 1,000 residents or per US$1bn GDP instead of absolute numbers.

items.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

countries.description: Two to five countries to compare

metric.description: Metric to compare, e.g. refugees, asylum_seekers, idps (default: refugees)

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

normalize_by.description: Normalize values by a denominator: "population" → per 1,000 residents, "gdp" → per US$1bn GDP. Requires the worldbank provider.

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: refugee_population
tools.description: Yearly displacement figures for a country: refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs, stateless and others. role "asylum" (default) = hosted in the country; role "origin" = displaced from it. Optionally cross-filter by a second country (e.g. Syrians hosted in Egypt). Paginated.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

other_country.description: Optional second country for the opposite role, e.g. country="Egypt", role="asylum", other_country="Syria" → Syrians in Egypt

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: demographics
tools.description: Latest age/sex breakdown of displaced people connected to a country (role "asylum" = hosted there, default; "origin" = from there). UNHCR publishes demographics for recent years only.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

tools.name: latest_statistics
tools.description: Most recent displacement figures. With a country: its latest hosted figures. Without: the latest global totals.

country.description: Country name or ISO3; omit for global totals

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

tools.name: asylum_applications
tools.description: Individual asylum applications lodged per year. role "asylum" (default) = applications filed IN the country; "origin" = filed BY nationals of the country abroad.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: asylum_decisions
tools.description: Decisions on individual asylum applications per year — recognized, complementary protection, rejected, otherwise closed — plus the recognition rate. role "asylum" (default) = decided IN the country.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: conflict_events
tools.description: Annual conflict event counts and fatalities for a country (ACLED via HDX). Pairs with refugee_population/trend_analysis to relate violence and displacement.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: food_security
tools.description: Latest IPC food-insecurity phase breakdown for a country: people per phase 1–5, with phase 3+ ("crisis or worse") as the headline. Data: IPC via HDX.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

tools.name: humanitarian_funding
tools.description: Humanitarian appeal requirements vs funding received per year for a country, with coverage percentage (OCHA FTS via HDX).

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: situation_reports
tools.description: Situation reports published about a country: yearly counts plus the most recent report titles and links (ReliefWeb). Use it to ground trends and anomalies from other tools in what was actually reported at the time.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

query.description: Free-text filter for the listed reports (e.g. "cholera") — yearly counts stay unfiltered

max_reports.description: How many of the most recent reports to list (default 5)

tools.name: trend_analysis
tools.description: Analyse how a displacement metric evolved for a country: yearly series, year-over-year changes, linear trend (slope, R²), CAGR and statistically anomalous years. Default: refugees hosted, last 10 years.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

metric.description: Metric: refugees, asylum_seekers, idps, stateless... (default refugees)

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Naive linear projection of a displacement metric 1–5 years ahead, based on the last 10 years. This is a statistical extrapolation, NOT a UNHCR planning figure — always present it with that caveat.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

tools.name: top_host_countries
tools.description: Rank countries by a displacement metric for a year. by="asylum" (default) ranks host countries; by="origin" ranks countries people fled from. Set normalize_by="population" to rank per 1,000 residents (or "gdp" per US$1bn) — the ranking that shows Lebanon and Chad ahead of large economies.

normalize_by.description: Normalize values by a denominator: "population" → per 1,000 residents, "gdp" → per US$1bn GDP. Requires the worldbank provider.

tools.name: generate_chart
tools.description: Render a displacement metric for one or more countries as a chart specification. Formats: "chartjs" (Chart.js v4 config JSON), "vega-lite" (v5 spec), "mermaid" (xychart block), "svg" (standalone image markup). Set normalize_by to plot per 1,000 residents or per US$1bn GDP.

items.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

normalize_by.description: Normalize values by a denominator: "population" → per 1,000 residents, "gdp" → per US$1bn GDP. Requires the worldbank provider.

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: generate_map
tools.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of country centroid points sized by a displacement metric — drop it into any GeoJSON viewer (geojson.io, Leaflet, Kepler). by="asylum" maps host countries, by="origin" maps origins.

by.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

tools.name: generate_country_report
tools.description: Compose a full markdown humanitarian situation report for a country: key figures, refugee trend with an embedded chart, origins of hosted refugees, asylum decisions and demographics. Reports progress while assembling.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Egypt", "EGY", "syria"

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Export normalized records from any dataset as csv, json, markdown or geojson (geojson only makes sense with group_by set, so rows map to countries). Use this when the user wants raw data to download or paste elsewhere.

dataset.description: population | demographics | asylum-applications | asylum-decisions | context-indicators | idps | conflict-events | humanitarian-funding | food-security

role.description: "asylum" = people hosted IN the country; "origin" = people displaced FROM the country

group_by.description: Break rows down per asylum or origin country instead of aggregating

year_from.description: First year of the range (default: 10 years back)

year_to.description: Last year of the range (default: latest available)

include_manifest.description: Attach an extraction manifest (exact arguments, timestamp, server version, citation) for reproducibility. Default true.

include_codebook.description: Attach a codebook documenting every exported variable (meaning, unit, derivation) — ready for a paper's data appendix. Default false.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Describe the connected data providers: datasets served, metrics available, attribution and terms. Call this to learn what data exists before querying.

tools.name: provider_health
tools.description: Liveness check of every connected data provider (latency, reachability). Use when queries fail to distinguish upstream outages from bad parameters.

instructions:
Humanitarian MCP exposes trusted humanitarian open data through semantic tools. Depending on configuration it serves: UNHCR refugee statistics (displacement, demographics, asylum), World Bank context indicators (national population, GDP — the denominators behind normalize_by per-capita views), HDX/HAPI crisis data (ACLED conflict events, IPC food security, OCHA FTS funding) and ReliefWeb situation reports (narrative context).

Conventions:
- Call get_metadata first to learn which providers and datasets are actually enabled.
- Countries accept names or ISO3 codes, in English or Arabic; when unsure of spelling, call search_country first.
- role="asylum" means people hosted IN a country; role="origin" means people displaced FROM it.
- All data is read-only, sourced from official public APIs, and cached locally. Displacement figures are end-year stocks. Cite the year and the `source` field of each payload — different tools draw on different providers, so never attribute everything to one source.
- Start broad (get_metadata, country_profile) before drilling into specific datasets; use situation_reports to ground trends and anomalies in published reporting.
